title: The Lorax
author: Dr. Seuss
summary: The Once-ler recounts how he chopped down every Truffula tree to make a profitable product, ignoring the small orange Lorax who spoke for the trees, and hands the last seed to a child.
readIf: you want a rhyming read-aloud that opens conversations about nature and greed.
skipIf: you dislike books with an obvious moral message.
